s: Shello ligrom kibbuy hanner ubo ch' seipim: ner doleq shehu munnach qarob el haddelet (neged petichat haddelet mammash), beinyan shekkesheyyiptechu haddelet yukal likbot im yenashsheb haruach mibbachutz — asur liptoach haddelet kenegdo, shemma yekabbennu haruach. Veap sheeno mitkavven lekibbuy, vedabar sheeno mitkavven muttar, mikkol maqom kevan sheim yenashsheb haruach i epshar shello yekabbeh, u"pesiq resheh velo yamut hu", lepikak ap beshaa sheen ruach menashsheb bachutz asur lepotchah, shemma yatchil lenashsheb miyyad sheyyatchil liptoach. Vaapillu im hanner hu munnach achore haddelet, kegon delet shenniptachat lipnim umeachareha munnach babbayit ner daluq — asur lepotchah im hanner hu qarob laddelet vehu (mekuvvan neged petichat haddelet mammash, dehaynu neged hechalal shebben haddelet lammezuza shehatztzirim qebuim bah mibbipnim, shechalal zeh naaseh al yede petichat haddelet). Abal im haddelet petucha kebar — muttar lenoolah bishbil shello yikbeh hanner, veen bezeh mishshum geram habara. Veken hachallon shekkeneged ner sheal hashshulchan — muttar lenoolo, veasur lepotcho, im hanner qarob elayv qetzat:

Veim hanner qabua bakkotel achore haddelet — asur liptoach haddelet kedarko bechol, shemma tehe haddelet noqeshet banner sheachoreha vei epshar shello tekabbennu keshettinnaqesh bo, u"pesiq resheh hu", ella yizzaher liptoach benachat shello tigga haddelet banner sheachoreha, abal lenoolah muttar bekol inyan. Veim hu beinyan shekkesheyyinol bechozeq kedarko tinnaqesh haddelet al hammezuza bechozeq kol kak ad shettenadned kol hakkotel utenadned ner haqqabua bo, veyitqareb qetzat hashshemen shebbanner etzel happetila, veyitchayyeb mishshum mabir, o yitracheq qetzat mimmenna, veyesh bazeh mishshum mekabbeh. Tzarik lizzaher ben bipticha ben binila shettehe benachat (beinyan shello yehe "pesiq resheh"), ap im hanner rachoq mehaddelet:

Veim hanner qabua baddelet atzmah, im hu shel shemen — asur liptoach o linol haddelet kedarko bechol, sheal yede happeticha uneila kedarko — i epshar shello yitqareb qetzat hashshemen el happetila (veyitchayyeb mishshum mabir), o yitracheq qetzat mimmennu (veyesh bo mishshum mekabbeh), ella poteach venoel benachat beinyan shello yehe "pesiq resheh". Veen issur betiltul haddelet mishshum hanner hammuqtzeh haqqabua bah, lepi shehaddelet lo naaset basis lanner, mippene shehi chashuba, shemmeshammeshet labbayit, ubetela etzlo velo lehanner. Veim hu ner shel shaava vekayotze bo — muttar liptoach velinol kedarko, ella im ken hu beinyan (sheyyesh lachush) sheyikbeh legamre im lo yizzaher liptoach velinol benachat. Abal im yippol al yede kak laaretz — en bekak kelum, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veken im hanner hu achore haddelet, vehu beinyan sheen lachush leharuach shemmibbachutz (kegon shehaddelet niptach mecheder lecheder), ella sheyyikbeh mechamat haddelet atzmah shemmenashshebet alayv im petachah kedarko bechol — tzarik lizzaher lepotchah benachat (beinyan shello yihyeh "pesiq resheh"):

Asur liptoach haddelet keneged hammedura haqqeroba qetzat el haddelet im haruach menashshebet mibbachutz, sheharuach mebaeret hammedura yoter, vaapillu en sham ella ruach metzuya sheenah mebaeret bevadday et hammedura, gezera mishshum ruach sheenah metzuya shehi mebaeret bevadday, u"pesiq resheh" hu. Abal im hayeta petucha keneged hammedura — muttar lesograh, veen bezeh mishshum mekabbeh:

Hinniach ner al gabbe tabla mibbeod yom veshakach lesalleqo mimmenna qodem shechasheka, venitzreka lo hattabla letaltelah ulehishtammesh bah beshabbat — menaer et hattabla vehanner nopel mealeha al haaretz, umetaltelah lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh. Ubilbad shello yitkavven lekabbot hanner beniur zeh, veap im nikba meelayv al yede nepilato — en bekak kelum, sheddabar sheeno mitkavven hu, veen kan "pesiq resheh", sheepshar shello yikbeh al yede kak. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshekkebar kala hashshemen mehanner velo nishar bo raq petila doleqet, o shehu ner shel shaava vekayyotze bo, abal ner sheyyesh bo shemen — asur lenaer hattabla lehappilo mealeha, lepi shei epshar shello yitqareb hashshemen qetzat el happetila veyitchayyeb mishshum mabir, o yitracheq qetzat mimmennu veyesh bo mishshum mekabbeh, vekol shekken im yishpok mimmennu qetzat. Umikkol maqom, muttar lomar lenokri lenaarah, shekkol "pesiq resheh" muttar al yede nokri, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"g. Ulepikak ap bener shel shaava vekayotze bo — tob shello yaaseh hayyisrael beatzmo, ella al yede nokri im epshar beqal limtzo nokri, o sheen tzarik lattabla kol kak. Veim tzarik limqom hattabla — yakol letaltelah im hanner shealeha apillu hu shel shemen leezeh maqom sheyyirtzeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"t:

Vekol zeh kesheshshakach lesalleq hanner mehattabla qodem kenisat hashshabbat, shellaken lo naaset hattabla basis ledabar hammuqtzeh, kevan sheenah meshammeshet az laner middaat baal habbayit, ella mechamat shikchato. Abal im middato hinniach hanner al hattabla sheyyihyeh aleha biknisat hashshabbat — hare naaset basis lehanner, utepela elayv, vaasura betiltul kamohu, lepikak asur lenaarah, ap im hanner hu shel shaava vekayotze bo, veap im tzarik limqom hattabla. Abal muttar ligga battabla, kemo shemmuttar ligga bekol muqtzeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"ch. Veal yede nokri muttar letaltelah ulenaarah, mittaam shennitbaer besimman ra"v. Veyesh omerim sheenah niqret basis ella im ken hayeta dato sheyyihyeh hanner aleha kol hashshabbat kullah, abal im haya dato lesalleqo achar kenisat hashshabbat al yede nokri, o al yede niur, o shear tiltul min hatztzad — hare zeh muttar lenaarah im hanner shel shaava vekayyotze bo. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bimqom hepsed, kegon ner sheal hashshulchan shennapal al hashshulchan vechoshesh shello yissarep hashshulchan — yenaer hashshulchan vehanner nopel mealayv im hu shel shaava vekayyotze bo, im haya dato mibbeod yom lesalleqo meal hashshulchan beshabbat al yede nokri o al yede tiltul min hatztzad. Veim napal hanner al hammappa sheal hashshulchan, ap al pi shehanner haya omed aleha biknisat hashshabbat — lo naaset hammappa basis lo ledibre hakkol, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman sh"t, veyakol lenaarah sheyyippol hanner mealeha, o shear muqtzeh shennapal aleha beshabbat, ap al pi sheen sham hepsed im lo yenaer. Veap im napal hanner o shear muqtzeh sheal hashshulchan shennaasa basis lehanner, shehaya munnach alayv biknisat hashshabbat, mikkol maqom im haya munnach al hashshulchan biknisat hashshabbat, dehaynu beben hashshemashot, gam lechem (shelletzorek hashshabbat) — hare naasa basis leissur ulehetter biknisat hashshabbat. Veap leachar shesillequ hallechem mimmennu — lo naasa basis lehanner bilbaddo, kevan shehu kebar achar kenisat hashshabbat. Ulepikak yakol lenaaro lehappil mealayv hanner ushear muqtzeh letaltelo achar kak kemo sheyyirtzeh. Veken im hayu munnachim alayv ben hashshemashot shear debarim sheenam muqtzim, vehu sheyyihyu (hallechem o) shear haddebarim chashubim yoter min deleqat hanner, dehaynu min hashshalhebet shehanner naasa basis eleha, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"t. Veim tzarik legup hashshulchan letaltelo lemaqom acher, im epshar lenaer mimmennu hanner (kegon sheen tzarik od lener zeh) — yenaarennu mimmennu mittechilla al yede sheyyatteh hashshulchan veyippol hanner mealayv, veachar kak yetaltelennu lemaqom sheyyirtzeh. Veim i epshar lenaer (kegon shehu tzarik od lener zeh bammaqom haacher, o sheyyesh chashash hepsed beniur zeh shello yishshaber hanner) — rashshay letaltelennu beod hanner alayv, hoil velo naasa basis lo bilbaddo beben hashshemashot. Vaapillu im eno tzarik od lanner, ella shetztzarik limqom hashshulchan, veim yenaer sham hanner lo yukal laasot cheptzo beoto maqom — muttar letaltel hashshulchan im hanner shealayv lemaqom acher, hoil velo naasa hashshulchan beben hashshemashot basis leissur bilbaddo, ukemo sheyyitbaer kol zeh besimman sh"t vesh"y, ayyen sham kol perate dinim ellu vetaamehem:

Muttar lehanniach ner shel shabbat mibbeod yom al gabbe ilan veyidloq sham beshabbat. Abal en mannichin ner shel yom tob doleq al hailan apillu mibbeod yom, gezera shemma yaaleh bailan beyom tob littol mimmennu hanner, venimtza mishtammesh bimchubbar laqqarqa beyom tob, shehu asur mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman shl"v. Abal beshabbat en lachush shemma yaaleh alayv littol hanner leachar sheyyikbeh, shehare hu asur betiltul ap leachar sheyyikbeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"t:

Muttar likpot qeara shel cheres al gabbe hanner bishbil shello yeechoz haur baqqora, shemmah shehu metaltel haqqeara beshabbat bishbil hatztzalat haqqora haasura betiltul beshabbat — en bezeh shum issur kelal. Vekol shekken shemmuttar likpotah al hanner kede leshammesh mittato. Umikkol maqom, tzarik sheyyanniach meat avir tachteha, sheim lo ken yikbeh hanner:
